# What the xrdp preview needs on Fedora on top of rpm.txt: its Wayland
# sessions (the wlup module: sway, and GNOME through Mutter's remote
# desktop API) and AV1. Same format as rpm.txt.

wayland-devel           wlup: Wayland client
wayland-protocols-devel wlup: protocol definitions
libxkbcommon-devel      wlup: keyboard layouts
libxkbfile-devel        keyboard rules (configure checks it on devel)
systemd-devel           wlup GNOME backend: the session's bus
pipewire-devel          wlup GNOME backend: screen capture
libei-devel             wlup GNOME backend: input (Mutter's ConnectToEIS)
libaom-devel            AV1 encoder (FreeRDP's GFX AV1 extension)
